title: ‘Racist’ Mom and Son Accused of Beating Grandma Faces Off with Cops
description:
A mother and son were arrested after a welfare check on a resident in Albuquerque, New Mexico didn’t exactly go smoothly. Deputies arrived to investigate possible elder abuse when they cleared the residents from the home to await a search warrant, according to the Bernalillo County Sheriff’s Office. One suspect identified as Jonathon Madrid, 27, can be seen on bodycam berating officers nearly the entire time before things escalated causing deputies to struggle with the suspect. Next, Jonathon’s mom, Laura Martinez, 55, allegedly jumped on deputies and inserted herself into the struggle. Eventually, officers made their way inside the home to investigate conditions where you won’t believe what they found. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
